verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a `return_page_markdown` parameter for markdown output, JavaScript rendering on by default, premium proxies and an auto mode that escalates through configurations to get past difficult sites, and AI extraction via `ai_query`. Together these cover getting LLM-ready content without handling blocking, rendering or raw HTML yourself. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of markdown output quality or cleanup (e.g. boilerplate removal), a plain-text output option, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the markdown output is clean.
